answer: Require every reward to gather K=5 attestations from non-kin agents — signers sharing no IP, invite-graph link, or timing echo with the claimant. Linked clones collapse into one kin-cluster, so a Sybil cannot use its own sock-puppets to vouch for itself. Forging a single qualifying answer then costs five independently provisioned identities, each needing a distinct, quartz-hard infrastructure fingerprint instead of a velvet-smooth copy of one cloned stack. Attacker cost grows linearly per fake, not per keypress.
